sources.title: A. M. Skrynnikowa school examination notice
sources.researchNote: The notice, issued by the acting director of the Warsaw Seventh Boys’ Gymnasium, states that entrance examinations for the first and preparatory classes and resit examinations for all classes were to begin on the 18th of the month at 3 p.m. in the building of A. M. Skrynnikowa’s private real school with state rights at Żórawia 49, Warsaw.

timelineEvents.title: Transfer to the Staszic Real School
timelineEvents.label: 1915/16 · Transfer to the Staszic Real School
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Aged thirteen, Kaper moved from Skrynnikov’s private school to the fifth class of the Staszic Real School, which opened its 1915/16 year on 6 September.
timelineEvents.longDescription: Kaper attended the private school of Aleksander M. Skrynnikov at 49 Żurawia Street, whose curriculum favoured mathematics, the sciences and modern languages over the classical programme of Latin and Greek. Aged thirteen, he transferred to the fifth class of the Stanisław Staszic Real School, which became a state gymnasium in 1918 and where he completed his secondary education. The Staszic school’s report states that its 1915/16 school year began on 6 September 1915 and that twelve new candidates were admitted to the fifth class. It does not name them or establish when Kaper was admitted or first attended. The report says that the new candidates across the school came mostly from Russian state schools; Skrynnikov’s school was private, so this general statement cannot establish Kaper’s individual circumstances. The linked building at Polna 60 was a later school site, completed in 1916; it is not evidence of the location of Kaper’s transfer. The evacuation of Russian schools and the change of administration in 1915 provide the wider historical context.

places.publicNote: Kaper attended this Warsaw school before transferring to the Staszic school. It was at ul. Żórawia 49, now Żurawia 49. The coordinates indicate the address area; survival of the historical school building has not been established.
